headline: Project Leader | Community Builder
summary: Project leader with experience managing teams, executing large-scale events, and securing partnerships across NGOs and organizations. Led initiatives with 1400+ participants and raised $12,000+ in funding. Focused on delivering structured, high-impact projects.

points: Managed planning and execution of 2 hackathons with 200+ participants
Coordinated cross-functional teams across 4 departments to deliver events on time
Secured partnerships with 2 government organizations and 4 NGOs
Raised over $10,000 in funding to support program execution and growth
Lead and manage a team of 20+ members across 4 departments
Secured partnerships with 1 government organization and 3 NGOs to support event operations
Raised $2,000+ in funding for youth volunteering initiatives
Directed end-to-end execution of 6 large-scale conferences with 1000+ participants
Oversaw planning, delegation, and delivery to ensure smooth event operations and participant experience
